links.comparator_used: Single LLM (each of the two individual Gemini LLMs)
links.outcome: Data abstraction error rate for pathology and MRI report variables
links.effect: Pathology: consensus median error 0.09% (IQR 0.03-0.16%) vs LLM 1 0.27% (IQR 0.09-0.34%) and LLM 2 0.30% (IQR 0.17-0.48%), about threefold higher for individual LLMs. MRI: consensus 0.17% (IQR 0.00-0.68%) vs 0.84% (IQR 0.34-2.79%) and 1.02% (IQR 0.34-1.67%).
links.quote: Individual LLMs had threefold higher error rates compared to consensus LLM (LLM 1: 0.27%(IQR 0.09-0.34%), LLM 2: 0.30%(IQR 0.17%-0.48%)).

design_hint: dual-LLM consensus vote for registry data abstraction
